WITH filtered_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate / rental_duration as ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT 
  ra.rating,
  ra.avg_ratio,
  ra.avg_ratio - om.overall_avg as difference
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ra.avg_ratio > om.overall_avg
